Then drag, pinch and rotate it until it looks right.
The lock screen keeps its current photo
On Android 12 and newer, a new wallpaper can also re-color your keyboard and system accents. Menu → Keyboard colors changed? shows how to keep the colors you want.
Lock screen updated. Lock your phone to see it.
Your lock screen will show your home screen wallpaper instead.

Android 12 and newer pick your phone's accent colors, keyboard included, from the wallpaper. On many phones they follow whichever wallpaper changed last, so a new lock screen photo can re-color the keyboard too. No app can change the wallpaper without this happening.

To keep the colors you want:

• Long-press your home screen, open Wallpaper & style, and pick one of the Basic colors (on Samsung: Color palette). Those stay put when the wallpaper changes.

• Or give the keyboard its own theme: in Gboard, open Settings → Theme and pick anything other than Dynamic color.
The phone refused the change. If a theme, Glance, Samsung\'s Dynamic Lock Screen or another lock screen app is turned on, switch it off and try again.

This phone blocks wallpaper changes. That is usually a work, school or carrier device-management profile, or a parental-control app, and no app can override it. Look in Settings for \"Device admin apps\" or a work profile; whoever set it up has to remove it.
